spec.claim_summary: The claim is that RSI and MACD bullish and bearish divergences predict profitable moves with over 85% and 90% success respectively.
spec.untestable_reason: Divergence is described only as chart arrows with no mechanical pivot, lookback, entry trigger, or exit, so no repeatable rule can be recovered.

claimed.other: Instances of Bearish Divergences (Red Arrows) 17 instances, probability of profitability > 90%

assumptions: No asset is named in the claim text; BTCUSDT is chosen as the reading for BTC noted in the provided context.
No timeframe is stated; 1d is assumed as the most natural reading for a TradingView idea.
NOT EXPRESSIBLE: bullish/bearish divergence requires comparing price swing highs/lows to RSI and MACD swing highs/lows with no pivot definition, lookback, or confirmation rule stated.
No entry trigger, exit condition, stop, target, or holding period is stated; without a mechanical divergence definition no repeatable rule can be recovered.
Direction is set to long to represent the bullish-divergence side; the bearish-divergence side is omitted because the schema allows one direction.
